_comment: RATIFIED PINS for the governing frame. Decision 29 (c38ea344) ratifies
docs/governing-frame.md as the bootstrap input to the doctrine snapshot.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS SEPARATELY: the generator must be deterministic AND the frame
must stay stable across incidental edits to the texts it pins. Deriving the pins from
live git HEAD would mint a new frame on every commit, which is exactly the
fragmentation Decision 28 Ruling 3 rejected. So the ratified revisions live here.
and they move only when doctrine is deliberately re-ratified -- a reviewed change to
THIS FILE, which is a doctrine change, not a routine edit.
CHANGING ANY VALUE HERE IS A DOCTRINE CHANGE and re-mints the bootstrap hash, which
deliberately starts a new B1/B3 cohort rather than contaminating an old one.

pins.note: Workspace operating doctrine. Not in a git repo, so it is pinned by its DECLARED version rather than a git SHA. A file edit that does not change the declared version does NOT move the frame.
Repository compiler contract; the strictest of the two CLAUDE.md files.
Role persona sources. Per-role variation is hashed separately as system_prompt_hash, so this pin names the SET, not each persona.
Procedure-card registry, PG->Redis synced. Active cards are hashed per-walk into the snapshot's card set, so this pin names the registry itself.
Pipeline authority. Deliberately NOT content-addressed: pinning live pipeline state would mint a new frame on every plan transition and fragment every cohort. Named as a live locator instead.
